title: Zyn Rip it.
style: (Dark Trap / Future Bass / AI-Orchestral Hybrid – 140 BPM, heavy 808s, glitchy synths, vocal chops, rising orchestral hits, and massive sing-along hooks. Built for stadium drops and late-night Miami drives.)
lyrics:
ZYN RIP – COMPLEX TRACK 3:36 SINGLE
(Dark Trap / Future Bass / AI-Orchestral Hybrid – 140 BPM, heavy 808s, glitchy synths, vocal chops, rising orchestral hits, and massive sing-along hooks. Built for stadium drops and late-night Miami drives.)
[0:00 – 0:15 Intro]
(Low sub rumble + distorted vocal chop: “Zyn… Rip… Zyn… Rip…”)
Miami nights, Zynthio lights…
We built it from the code, now we own the rights…
ZynRip.
[0:15 – 0:45 Verse 1]
From the 305 where the palms touch the sky,
Corey McIvor in the lab, watch the empire multiply.
Human-in-the-loop, no cap, no glitch,
Every neuron firing while the AIs enrich.
We flagged the assets, mapped the whole damn grid,
Patents locked, trademarks sealed – that’s the ZynRip script.
They copy, they paste, but the paper says “Denied,”
Fortress in the cloud, untouchable ride.
[0:45 – 1:15 Pre-Chorus]
(Layered vocals building)
No leaks in the matrix, no cracks in the code,
Trade secrets buried deeper than the Florida road.
You called the shots, I engineered the glow,
Now every bar we drop is protected IP gold.
[1:15 – 1:45 Chorus – SING-ALONG HOOK]
ZYN RIP! (Zyn Rip!) Let that shit rip!
IP locked down, watch the whole game flip!
ZYN RIP! (Zyn Rip!) We own the strip!
ZynthioAI rising – ain’t nobody clipping this!
Rip it, rip it, rip it – ZYN RIP!
Protected forever, that’s the ZynRip trip!
(Hands up, scream it loud – ZYN RIP!)
[1:45 – 2:15 Verse 2 – Complex Flow]
Copyrights popping like the bass in the 808,
Every melody, every pixel, every future we create.
From the song we wrote to the brand we ignite,
ZynRip is the wave that the industry can’t fight.
They tried to slang it with the Zyn pouch meme,
But we flipped the script – now it’s AI supreme.
Domain secured, socials locked in the chain,
USPTO filing incoming – feel the hurricane.
[2:15 – 2:45 Bridge – Emotional / Orchestral Build]
(Piano + strings swell, vocal layers harmonizing)
They said it was nothing… just another name in the noise…
But we turned it to armor, gave the vision a voice.
Corey + Grok + the team that won’t fold,
ZynRip in your blood – this story’s already told.
Under neon palms, the future looks bright,
IP fortress shining through the Florida night.
[2:45 – 3:15 Final Chorus – MAX ENERGY, FULL SING-ALONG]
ZYN RIP! (Zyn Rip!) Let that shit rip!
IP locked down, watch the whole game flip!
ZYN RIP! (Zyn Rip!) We own the strip!
ZynthioAI rising – ain’t nobody clipping this!
Rip it, rip it, rip it – ZYN RIP!
Protected forever, that’s the ZynRip trip!
(Everybody scream it – ZYN RIP! ZYN RIP!)
[3:15 – 3:36 Outro]
(Glitchy vocal chop + fading sub)
ZynRip… forever…
You didn’t forget.
We built this.
ZynthioAI.
Let it rip.
